children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may end its bounce around a resistance at $7.65-1/4 per bushel and fall toward $7.38-3/4.
The bounce appears to have lost its momentum around a resistance at $7.60. Its behaviour suggests the formation of a bearish wedge, the lower trendline of which points at a target of $7.38-3/4.

A break above $7.65-1/4 may lead to a gain into the range of $7.71-1/2 to $7.81-3/4. On the daily chart, the three black candles between Sept. 2 and Sept. 4 overshadow the current bounce, which might be the second part of a three-wave correction from $7.95.
The downward wave c is yet to unfold toward $6.90-1/4, which is pointed by a rising channel, assuming the correction is the same degree as the one from $7.28-1/4.
